contract_answer.question: Does replacing Relative Huber with standardized-target MSE change the three-split MAPE by at least 0.008 on the frozen NA-E009 recipe?
contract_answer.conclusion: Direct recomputation of all 600 selected-checkpoint predictions gives split-42 MAPE 0.120335, Acc@15 0.666667, RMSE 40.5604 cycles, and bias -20.2699 cycles, versus NA-E010 at 0.116952, 0.700000, 41.2605, and -21.7183. Across NA-E029/030/031, MSE is 0.106198 +/- 0.029159 MAPE versus Relative Huber 0.108654 +/- 0.008549: the -0.002456 difference is inside the registered +/-0.008 band, so the family result is TIED. The existing split-level decision is DISCARD.

main_symptom: On split 42 MSE raises MAPE by 0.00338 and lowers Acc@15 by 0.03333, while the completed family has substantially greater split variance and no meaningful mean-MAPE change.

causes.class: evaluation variance: six validation cells per split make the MSE effect unstable
supporting_evidence: validation_predictions.npz::cell_id has 6 unique cells and 600 prefix samples
MSE split MAPEs are 0.072665/0.120335/0.125594 versus Relative Huber 0.099874/0.116952/0.109135
MSE MAPE sample std is 0.029159 versus 0.008549 for Relative Huber
contradicting_evidence: Split-42 RMSE improves slightly by 0.70 cycles
All predictions and training diagnostics are finite
causes.interpretation: The small split-42 regression is not decisive alone, but together with the opposing split effects it shows that the large split-2021 gain is not robust.

causes.class: objective tradeoff: MSE slightly changes bias and prefix allocation without improving this split
supporting_evidence: NA-E010 parent bands are 0.1909/0.1495/0.1269/0.0942/0.0813, so only 01-10 improves while every later band worsens
Bias remains strongly negative, moving only from -21.7183 to -20.2699 cycles, while prediction/target spread falls from 0.6667 to 0.6459
causes.interpretation: MSE modestly helps the earliest prefixes and cycle-weighted RMSE, but does not fix underprediction and degrades the bulk of prefix bands and MAPE.
missing_evidence: A larger Na-ion validation cohort would be needed to estimate loss-by-cell interactions precisely
